<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2007|month=06|day=24|content=

* [[Mauricio Macri]], a member of the [[Argentine National Congress|National Congress]] of [[Argentina]] and president of [[Boca Juniors]], is elected as the [[Chiefs of Government of Buenos Aires|Chief of Government of Buenos Aires]]. [http://edition.cnn.com/2007/WORLD/americas/06/24/argentina.election.reut/index.html?eref=rss_world (Reuters via CNN)]
* [[Ali Hassan al-Majid]], better known as "Chemical Ali," is [[death penalty|sentenced to death]] for his role in [[Al-Anfal_Campaign|killing 180,000]] [[Kurd]]s under [[Saddam Hussein]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/stories/2007/06/25/1960488.htm (BBC via ABC News Australia)]
* A roadside [[bomb]] hits a [[United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon]] patrol, killing six [[Spanish language|Spanish]]-speaking peacekeepers (three of whom were [[Colombia]]n) and injuring two others. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/6235224.stm (BBC)]
* More than 200 people die in accidents related to [[storm]]s in [[Karachi]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20070929091552/http://www.itv.com/news/world_b1ed6babae5ab4afcb7310d567f5c028.html (ITV)]
* ''[[Politics of the United Kingdom|Government of the United Kingdom]]:''
** [[Gordon Brown]] becomes the Leader of the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]], replacing [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Tony Blair]]. Brown will replace Blair on [[27 June]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk_politics/6234048.stm (BBC)]
** [[Harriet Harman]] becomes [[Deputy Leader of the Labour Party (UK)|Deputy Leader]] of the [[Labour Party (UK)|Labour Party]], replacing [[Deputy Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Deputy Prime Minister]] [[John Prescott]]. She is not expected to follow Prescott as Deputy Prime Minister, and won the [[Labour Party (UK) deputy leadership election, 2007|Labour deputy leadership election]] with 50.43%, narrowly beating [[Alan Johnson]].  [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk_politics/6234692.stm (BBC)]
